mutations.why: The CRLF round-trip test claims an anchor authored with LF matches a CRLF source. Removing the line-ending conversion is the exact bug that lost 3 of 8 mutations in gaw v0.13-s8 -- if the test cannot see it, it is not guarding what it says.
mutations.label: apply-mutation:eol
mutations.expectRed: the silent-skip bug: an LF-authored anchor did not match a CRLF source

mutations.why: The manifest validator claims to reject duplicate mutation ids. Results are keyed by id and --only selects by id, so a duplicate silently drops one of two mutations -- a skipped mutation that reads as a clean run.
mutations.label: manifest:duplicate-id
mutations.expectRed: a duplicate mutation id was accepted, so one of two mutations would be silently dropped

mutations.why: verifyRestored claims to catch a revert whose bytes on disk differ from what was written. That gap -- 'we wrote the original back' versus 'the original is on disk' -- is the encoding corruption that motivated this whole tool.
mutations.label: mutate:verify-restored
mutations.expectRed: a revert whose bytes on disk differ from what was written was accepted as clean
